classification_taxonomy.VERIFIED_EXTREME: 24-hour rainfall exceeding 204.4 mm (IMD Extremely Heavy Rainfall) or localized flash flooding confirmed by official ground station/IMD data.
classification_taxonomy.VERIFIED_HEAVY: 24-hour rainfall between 64.5 mm and 204.4 mm (IMD Heavy to Very Heavy) verified by rain gauges.
classification_taxonomy.MONSOON_EVENT: Active monsoonal precipitation episode observed via satellite/radar without external station extreme verification.
classification_taxonomy.CANDIDATE: Candidate event identified from satellite/model coverage windows.
classification_taxonomy.UNVERIFIED: Event record pending external station archive verification.
